title: Exact verification, explicit homotopy, and parameter restrictions for Family 199
description:
Three source-pinned component contributions concerning OpenAI mathematics Family199, not a verification of the full Auslander–Reiten or Tachikawa counterexamples. The unchanged predecessors comprise an exact179-entry cocycle certificate (104,976 quadruples and324 boundary pairs, two polynomial implementations) and an explicit twisted bar homotopy with a written all-degree identity and17,050-generator finite replay.

Version1.2.0 adds a parameter audit of the displayed seed resolution. Over any characteristic-two field, the specified augmented complex is exact precisely for q=0 or q of infinite multiplicative order. A nontrivial root of order d first fails in degree d-1; q=1 fails at the augmentation. At q=0 exactness survives but Ext in every degree n≥2 has dimension two. A uniform coordinate proof is supported by exact kernel/image and quotient-witness checks for all30 q in F2,F4,F8,F16 (710 degrees in each complex), an independent XOR-only binary-matrix oracle (526 degree cases),12 tests and three rejecting controls in ordinary and optimized Python.

The source assumes transcendental q and is not contradicted. Generic sufficient conditions already occur in the source Lean development. The new result limits this unchanged specialization mechanism; it does not rule out other resolutions or finite-field constructions. At roots of unity the dual computation is Hom-complex cohomology, not Ext. Written proofs, finite computation and scoped AI reviews are explicitly separated from kernel verification and human review.
